message.content:
The Pacers are playing the **Oklahoma City Thunder** in the **2025 NBA Finals**.[1][4]

If you meant their *next playoff opponent* during the 2025 run, they beat the **New York Knicks** in the Eastern Conference Finals to reach the Finals.[1][3]
